domain: cancer evolution and resistance hidden-state identifiability, cycle 3
overall_verdict: moment-matched hidden-state mechanisms can change resistant-lineage risk beyond CLE, but the complete branching baseline captures them exactly; candidate ecDNA and PGCC mechanisms and lineage assays have direct prior art; no biological rates or patient-level risk estimate are identified

claims.statement: For a PGCC with competing memoryless death and burst hazards delta and beta, instantaneous burst offspring PGF h, and independent post-burst daughter extinction probability q_R, the probability that the PGCC generates at least one lineage that never goes extinct is beta/(beta+delta) * (1-h(q_R)). For N independent PGCCs the risk is 1-(1-p_G)^N, and for Poisson(N; Lambda) it is 1-exp(-Lambda*p_G).
assumptions: constant competing hazards in the modeled treatment phase
post-burst daughters evolve independently with common extinction probability q_R
no density dependence, shared environment, or unmodeled state transitions
claims.status: internally derived exact conditional branching result; PGF/branching method is established prior art
claims.novelty_boundary: No novelty claim. This is standard first-event conditioning in a branching model specialized to a PGCC burst state.
claims.costs: Requires event-resolved PGCC formation, beta and delta, the complete viable burst-size distribution, post-burst daughter establishment, follow-up censoring and spatial coverage; none is jointly supplied by cited papers.
claims.falsifier: Held-out lineage outcomes violate the frozen PGCC competing-risk/offspring-PGF prediction after the stated censoring and state-classification model is applied.
claims.next_gate: Acquire full mother-to-burst-to-clonogenic-daughter lineages and a simultaneous finite-sample parameter region, then assess held-out calibration against a fully informed branching baseline.

claims.statement: Two PGCC burst laws with the same mean K=4 can yield different exact establishment probabilities: with q_R=1/2 and beta/(beta+delta)=1/2, deterministic K=4 gives p_G=0.46875, while K=0 with probability 3/4 and K=16 with probability 1/4 gives p_G=0.1249981.
claims.status: exact illustrative counterexample; not fitted to biological data
claims.novelty_boundary: Higher-offspring moments enter the PGF and extinction probability by established branching-process theory; no novelty claim.
claims.costs: A meaningful application requires the measured full offspring PGF and daughter establishment probability; mean burst yield alone is insufficient.
claims.falsifier: Exact rational substitution into h(q_R) contradicts either value, or an empirical frozen offspring-law prediction fails held-out lineage data.
claims.next_gate: Do not report a tumor-risk point estimate without the distributional and rate inputs.

claims.statement: Under an ordinary binary division event with a fully observed typed offspring count vector Z satisfying sum_j Z_j=2, the full first and second factorial moments determine the offspring distribution: P(Z=e_j+e_k)=E[Z_j Z_k] for j!=k and P(Z=2e_j)=E[Z_j(Z_j-1)]/2. Thus no two such fully resolved binary-division laws can share all first/second vector moments while differing in PGF.
assumptions: all daughter types and pair identity are resolved
moments are conditional on parent type and event class
claims.novelty_boundary: Elementary finite-support moment identity; no novelty claim. Hidden/coarsened types, unobserved sister pairing, or unknown clocks restore aliasing.
claims.costs: Requires linked parent and both daughters plus complete type measurement; aggregate tumor counts do not meet this interface.
claims.falsifier: A counterexample satisfying the assumptions violates the displayed reconstruction identities.
claims.next_gate: Use this boundary to separate ordinary ecDNA partition questions from variable-offspring PGCC burst questions.

claims.statement: For the constructed ecDNA partition kernels conditional on four pre-replication copies, both sister-pair laws conserve eight copies and have identical mean (4,4) and covariance [[2,-2],[-2,2]], while P(max daughter copy>=6) is 1/2 versus 1/8 and the fourth cumulants of one daughter are -4 versus 20. If the high-tail state independently establishes with probability 1/2, the per-mitosis establishment probabilities are 3/8 versus 3/32.
assumptions: each high-tail daughter independently establishes with probability 1/2
claims.status: exact rational construction and finite arithmetic verification; kernels are not asserted to be biological
claims.novelty_boundary: Moment-matching construction is mathematical illustration and is not claimed as a new mechanism; current ecDNA prior art already measures stress-dependent segregation.
claims.costs: A measurement requires event-linked parent and sister counts and daughter clonogenic follow-up. The stated 26 complete divisions per arm for about 80% power assumes a large predeclared tail contrast, 0.90 sensitivity, 0.01 false-tail rate, MCAR completion and independent divisions.
claims.falsifier: With calibrated calls and matched parent states, the held-out tail frequency is inconsistent with the frozen partition kernel, or the tail does not predict durable resistant outgrowth.
claims.next_gate: Treat as a preclinical assay-identifiability example only; no patient or whole-tumor inference without spatial coverage and transportable rates.

claims.statement: Current primary reports establish selected ecDNA reconfiguration and PGCC daughter generation but do not jointly supply the event clock, full offspring kernel, daughter establishment, censoring and spatial-coverage inputs needed for a calibrated whole-tumor resistance risk from these models.
assumptions: scope limited to the cited studies and examined reports
absence means not jointly reported in the reviewed source, not biologically absent
claims.status: bounded literature/data-interface audit; external priority is not claimed
claims.novelty_boundary: No claim that these are the only relevant studies or that no such dataset exists; the conclusion is restricted to the primary papers reviewed in the linked source audits.
claims.costs: Full empirical risk would require lineage imaging, event/copy calls, long follow-up, clonogenic assays, simultaneous uncertainty analysis and spatial representation; no costs or experiments were measured in this research pass.
claims.falsifier: An existing or newly acquired dataset supplies all required linked inputs with sufficient precision and validates a frozen model against held-out lineages.
claims.next_gate: Only continue as a finite-data predictive validation project if linked primary data or assay access are available; otherwise stop novelty development on this candidate.

status_note: All constructions are mathematical and conditional. No treatment or intervention recommendation, biological fit, clinical claim, or external expert review is present.
